info.title: GATEWAY-batchinsertion-List Support Tickets Reopens-v4-spec
info.description: The Support Tickets Reopen API allows businesses to effectively manage and retrieve information about reopened support tickets. It provides developers with the capability to list all support tickets that have been marked for reopening, ensuring that teams can track ongoing customer issues. This API is typically utilized by customer support and operations teams looking to maintain high levels of service and responsive communication with clients. By using this endpoint, organizations can streamline their ticket management processes, enhancing overall customer satisfaction.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to reopen a previously closed ticket, making it active once again. Use this operation when issues that led to the ticket's closure need further attention or resolution.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to reopen an existing ticket. It must contain the necessary information required to identify the ticket that should be reopened.

204.description: The request was successful, but there is no content to return.
